title: Residency Applications for a Home-Site Lease
content:
A residency application for a Home-Site Lease names one site, and the lot class of that site fixes the entry gate the home must meet.

**Rules applied at the resident desk**

- **Home fit.** The home's section type, length and model year meet the entry gate of the lot class applied for. These home facts are taken from the title or data plate the applicant supplies and are recorded on the application exactly as shown there; they are the applicant's statement, tied to the site number named on the application. A home that misses any one limit cannot be placed on that lot class, and the applicant may instead apply for a site of a lot class whose gate it meets.
- **Household.** The registered household may not exceed the lot class's most persons of any age, and every adult aged 18 or over is listed and screened.
- **Term.** The requested term must be one the lot class offers (month to month, twelve months or twenty-four months, as available on that lot class).
- **Application fee.** The fee equals the lot class's application fee per adult multiplied by the number of adults listed. It is charged on the application date and is not refunded on denial or withdrawal.
- **Decision.** Approval or denial is decided by the community office after screening and is never made or promised by the resident desk.
- **Withdrawal.** An applicant may withdraw at any time before signing.

**Where an application can go**

| From | To | By |
|---|---|---|
| applied | approved | the community office, after the background, income and home-eligibility review |
| applied | denied | the community office |
| applied | closed | the applicant, withdrawing before a decision |
| approved | closed | the approved applicant, declining to sign and withdrawing |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical applications)**

| Application | Result |
|---|---|
| Data plate shows a home that meets the length and model-year limits but is of the other section type | cannot be placed on that lot class; may apply for a lot class whose gate it meets |
| Two adults listed, per-adult fee 50.00 | fee of 100.00 charged on the application date |
| The same applicant withdraws after paying the fee | the fee is not refunded |
| Month-to-month term requested on a lot class that offers no month-to-month term | the requested term is not one the lot class offers |
